title: Nutmeg-Spiced Calabrian Christmas Pudding Fritters
description: A pillowy Italian dessert featuring Christmas pudding, nutmeg, and a crispy Calabrian-inspired coating. Perfect for weeknight dessert or breakfast.
instructions: In a molcajete, combine flour and baking powder, and mix well.
Grate the nutmeg on top of the flour mixture, and mix to combine.
Add the eggs and milk to the flour mixture, and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick skillet with about 1 cm of vegetable oil over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, carefully drop spoonfuls of the batter into the oil, and flatten slightly with a spatula.
Cook the fritters for about 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels, and dust with a pinch of nutmeg and chili flakes.
Serve warm or at room temperature, with a dollop of whipped cream or a sprinkle of powdered sugar, if desired.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining batter.
Serve the fritters immediately, and enjoy!
Store any leftover fritters in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days.
Reheat the fritters in the microwave or oven before serving.
To make the fritters extra crispy, you can chill the batter in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before frying.
